"""One ordinary stock declaration-linter environment on an already-built cohort.

Executed inside the existing managed native phase, not a dispatcher or lease owner.
The sole argument is the frozen packet serialized as JSON. All new files stay in
the managed run directory. No package compilation or production artifact writes.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import tomllib
import uuid


def digest(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def flatten_options(value, prefix=''):
    result = {}
    for key, item in value.items():
        name = prefix + key
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            result.update(flatten_options(item, name + '.'))
        else:
            result[name] = item
    return result


def imports(text):
    # Erase nested Lean comments and line comments before reading the header.
    # Imports may wrap after `import`; Lean's import syntax has one module each.
    depth, out, i = 0, [], 0
    while i < len(text):
        if not depth and text[i:i+2] == '--':
            end = text.find('\n', i)
            i = end if end != -1 else len(text)
        elif text[i:i+2] == '/-':
            depth += 1
            i += 2
        elif depth and text[i:i+2] == '-/':
            depth -= 1
            i += 2
        else:
            out.append('\n' if text[i] == '\n' else (' ' if depth else text[i]))
            i += 1
    assert depth == 0, 'Unterminated source comment'
    clean = ''.join(out).lstrip()
    for directive in ('module', 'prelude'):
        clean = re.sub(r'^' + directive + r'\b\s*', '', clean, count=1)
    result = []
    while clean:
        match = re.match(r'(?:(?:public|meta)\s+)*import\s+(?:all\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)*)\b', clean)
        if not match:
            assert not re.match(r'(?:(?:public|meta)\s+)*import\b', clean), 'Unsupported import header'
            break
        result.append(match[1])
        clean = clean[match.end():].lstrip()
    return result


def main(packet):
    w = Path.cwd().resolve()
    lean = Path(os.environ['LEAN'])
    run = lean.parents[2]
    assert (run / 'compiler-config.json').is_file(), 'Managed compiler overlay required'
    profile = json.loads(os.environ['R5_LEAN_REMOTE_PROFILE'])
    assert profile['lean'] == str(lean)
    assert all(profile[k] == v for k, v in packet['profile'].items()), 'Admitted profile differs from packet'
    lake = os.environ['LAKE']
    assert str(w) == packet['workspace']
    assert packet['producing_run'] and packet['ready_cpp'] is True
    producing = run.parent / packet['producing_run'] / 'receipt.json'
    producer = json.loads(producing.read_text())
    assert producer['workspace'] == str(w)
    assert producer['group_closed'] is True and producer['exit_code'] == 0
    assert producer['source_content_sha256'] == packet['source_content_sha256']
    roots = packet['roots']
    assert roots and len(set(roots)) == len(roots)
    assert all(re.fullmatch(r'Aglib(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)+', m) for m in roots)
    expected = dict(packet['source_sha256'])
    targets = {p[:-5].replace('/', '.') for p in expected if p.startswith('Aglib/') and p.endswith('.lean')}
    assert targets and set(roots) <= targets
    config_names = ('lakefile.toml', 'lake-manifest.json', 'lean-toolchain')
    assert set(config_names) <= set(packet['configuration_sha256'])
    expected.update(packet['configuration_sha256'])
    manifest = json.loads((w / 'lake-manifest.json').read_text())
    batteries = next(p for p in manifest['packages'] if p['name'] == 'batteries')
    assert batteries['rev'] == 'f2effa3d803fda822b1f97b806c47cf2adfbcbc2'
    bdir = w / '.lake/packages/batteries'
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(bdir), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() == batteries['rev']
    # These small native predicate inputs join the ordinary source/artifact guard.
    for p in (bdir / 'scripts/runLinter.lean', bdir / '.lake/build/bin/runLinter'):
        expected[str(p)] = digest(p)
    config = tomllib.loads((w / 'lakefile.toml').read_text())
    options = flatten_options(next(lib['leanOptions'] for lib in config['lean_lib'] if lib['name'] == 'AglibModules'))
    assert options == packet['lean_options'], 'Current package options differ from packet'

    graph = {}
    def closure(module):
        if module in graph:
            return graph[module]
        p = w / (module.replace('.', '/') + '.lean')
        assert p.is_file(), 'Missing coherent package source: ' + str(p)
        graph[module] = {module}
        for dep in imports(p.read_text()):
            if dep.startswith('Aglib.'):
                graph[module].update(closure(dep))
        return graph[module]
    coverages = {m: closure(m) for m in roots}
    covered = set().union(*coverages.values())
    assert targets <= covered, 'Terminal roots do not import target family: ' + repr(sorted(targets - covered))
    # Source graph decides dominance; actual compilation remains the producer's.
    dominating = next((m for m in roots if targets <= coverages[m]), None)
    lib = w / '.lake/build/lib/lean'
    # Retain the producer's stable provider baseline. Do not rehash thousands of
    # unchanged provider artifacts for a scoped final predicate. Fresh guards
    # cover the exact target family, matching the existing native templates.
    assert all((lib / (m.replace('.', '/') + '.olean')).is_file() for m in covered), 'Cohort imports are not all already built'
    artifact_paths = [lib / (m.replace('.', '/') + '.' + ext)
                      for m in sorted(targets) for ext in ('olean', 'ilean')]
    assert all(p.is_file() for p in artifact_paths), 'Target producer artifacts are missing'
    assert not (w / 'scripts/nolints.json').exists()

    def guard():
        assert json.loads((w.parent / 'SOURCE.json').read_text())['content_sha256'] == packet['source_content_sha256']
        assert not (w / 'scripts/nolints.json').exists()
        for name, value in expected.items():
            assert digest(w / name) == value, 'Source/predicate changed: ' + name
        return {str(p.relative_to(w)): digest(p) for p in artifact_paths}

    artifacts = guard()
    commands = []
    def check(kind, argv, env=None):
        print('SHARED_LINT_COMMAND ' + json.dumps({'kind': kind, 'argv': argv}), flush=True)
        start = time.monotonic()
        with (run / (kind + '.log')).open('w') as log:
            result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=w, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        row = {'kind': kind, 'argv': argv, 'exit': result.returncode,
               'seconds': time.monotonic() - start, 'log': str(run / (kind + '.log'))}
        commands.append(row)
        print('SHARED_LINT_RESULT ' + json.dumps(row), flush=True)
        if result.returncode:
            print((run / (kind + '.log')).read_text(errors='replace')[-16000:], flush=True)
        return result.returncode

    scratch = run / 'shared-native-lint-batch'
    scratch.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    selected = dominating
    code = 0
    header = None
    if not selected:
        selected = 'Aglib.NativeLintCohort' + uuid.uuid4().hex
        header = scratch / (selected.replace('.', '/') + '.lean')
        header.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        header.write_text('module\n' + ''.join('public import ' + m + '\n' for m in roots))
        # Explicit current AglibModules options, ordinary managed compiler, and
        # --root preserve the actual Aglib module identity outside the package.
        option_args = ['-D' + k + '=' + (str(v).lower() if isinstance(v, bool) else str(v))
                       for k, v in options.items()]
        code = check('compile-import-only-header', [lake, '--no-build', 'env', str(lean),
                     '--root=' + str(scratch), *option_args, '-o', str(header.with_suffix('.olean')),
                     '-i', str(header.with_suffix('.ilean')), str(header)])
        if code == 0:
            assert header.with_suffix('.olean').is_file()
    if code == 0:
        env = dict(os.environ)
        if header:
            env['LEAN_PATH'] = str(scratch) + os.pathsep + env.get('LEAN_PATH', '')
        code = check('stock-declaration-shared-environment',
                     ['timeout', '--kill-after=30s', '20m', lake, '--no-build', 'exe',
                      'batteries/runLinter', '--no-build', '--trace', selected], env)
    assert guard() == artifacts, 'Subject artifacts changed during native lint'
    out = {**packet, 'question': 'One ordinary full native declaration lint on ready original etale27 imported package union',
           'selected_module': selected, 'mode': 'existing-dominating-root' if dominating else 'scratch-import-only-union',
           'target_modules': sorted(targets), 'covered_aglib_modules': sorted(covered),
           'source_and_predicate_sha256': expected, 'artifact_sha256': artifacts,
           'header': str(header) if header else None, 'commands': commands, 'exit_code': code,
           'predicate': 'Pinned stock Batteries getDeclsInPackage Aglib; getChecks slow=true/runAlways=None/runOnly=None; lintCore unchanged.',
           'scope_boundary': 'Combined imported package environment. Global simp/context-sensitive checks can differ from separate root environments. No claim of environment identity or measured speedup.',
           'provider_evidence_boundary': 'Unchanged provider source/artifact baseline retained from producing run and packet retained_evidence under exclusive workspace lease. Import graph/presence checked; providers are not broadly rehashed. Fresh before/after hashes cover exact target family, configuration and stock predicate inputs.',
           'retained_boundary': 'Existing compatible CPP, builtin/style, approved-axiom, and other native checks retain their original source/artifact/environment scope. This check adds declaration union coverage only.'}
    (run / 'SHARED-NATIVE-LINT-RESULT.json').write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('SHARED_LINT_SUMMARY ' + json.dumps({'exit': code, 'mode': out['mode'],
          'selected_module': selected, 'targets': len(targets), 'covered_aglib_modules': len(covered),
          'result': str(run / 'SHARED-NATIVE-LINT-RESULT.json')}), flush=True)
    return code


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main(json.loads(sys.argv[1])))
